repos.description: [JMLR 2023] Quantus is an eXplainable AI toolkit for responsible evaluation of neural network explanations

The Infosys Responsible AI toolkit incorporates various features including safety, security, explainability, fairness, bias and hallucination detection to ensure AI solutions are trustworthy and transparent.
Open-source toolkit for responsible AI: CLI + SDK to scan code, collect evidence, and generate model cards, risk files, evals, and RAG indexes.
